name: Single or Program-Specific Federal Audit
description: Single or program-specific audit required in any fiscal year the District expends $1,000,000 or more in federal awards.
deadline: Each fiscal year federal expenditures reach $1,000,000
quote: For any fiscal year in which the district expends $1,000,000 or more in federal awards, the district is required to have a single or program-specific audit in compliance with federal requirements.
